fato_historico: 614: King Chlothar II promulgates the Edict of Paris (Edictum Chlotacharii), a sort of Frankish Magna Carta that defends the rights of the Frankish nobles while it excludes Jews from all civil employment in the Frankish Kingdom.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to balance your powerful intensity with structural clarity. Just as ancient edicts once sought to harmonize social order through defined rights, you may find that establishing healthy boundaries strengthens your personal foundation. It is a good time to prune what no longer serves you and reclaim your inner authority with grace and purpose.
frase_do_dia: True power flows when you align your deep emotions with clear intentions.
significado_numero: Represents the cycle of personal evolution and the mastery of intuition.
conselho: Consider your next step with patience and honor your own inner truth.
